name: Ai Suru Kanojo wa Gamen no Mukou de Iki Kuruu ~Kanshi Camera Goshi ni Misetsukerareru Koibito no Haishin Sex~
original_name: 愛する彼女は画面の向こうでイキ狂う ～監視カメラ越しに見せつけられる恋人の背信セックス～
source:
Inui Tomo, a college student, has a lover. A beautiful, cheerful and energetic college girl Mikuriya Ai. After getting to know each other in high school, Tomo confessed and they began dating.

They had sex once in a while, went on a date, their relationship was going smoothly without any problem.

One day, Tomo's father contacts him and entrusts him with a job of managing his uncle's apartment building due to his uncle's sudden illness. He reluctantly takes the job, in the manager's room, he immediately sees an unexpected scene on the surveillance camera.

His beloved lover is having an affair. There should not be any problem in their relationship, yet his lover's face is constantly smiling and seems to be in a good mood.

Is this an affair? If so, how can he know for sure? At that time, he realizes his position as the manager.

That's it. He has the ability to put in her room, a surveillance camera──

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1245954]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
大学生干智有一个恋人。美丽、开朗、充满活力的女大学生御厨爱。高中时期认识后，Tomo坦白了，他们开始约会。

他们偶尔做爱，约会，他们的关系进展顺利，没有任何问题。

有一天，由于叔叔突然生病，Tomo的父亲联系了他，委托他管理叔叔的公寓楼。他无奈地接受了这份工作，在经理室里，他立刻在监控摄像头上看到了意想不到的一幕。

他心爱的情人有外遇。他们的关系应该没有什么问题，可他爱人的脸上却一直挂着笑容，看上去心情很好。

这是外遇吗？如果是这样，他怎么能确定呢？那时，他意识到自己作为经理的地位。

就是这样。他有能力在她的房间里安放监控摄像头——
